title: Story premise ENT043: The Festival of Falling Curtains
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (block-world chain reactions). Hook: Pull one curtain. Reveal the next job. Takeaway/theme: Reveal only the next actionable step when order matters.
description: A block troupe needs to reveal five stage scenes in order, but all curtains are tangled on one shared rail. They separate the rail into staggered tracks so each lowered curtain exposes the release tab for the next, revealing a traveling story whose final scene is the waiting audience.
